title: StateManager (A/B, noise profile, alignment storage, presets) and PluginEditor skeleton
description:
Implement state engine and a minimal PluginEditor skeleton that wires to the processor.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp from a.2
- Source/ParameterIDs.h
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/chuggate/.abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md (state, presets, A/B, noise profile, DI alignment storage)
- Sibling editor stubs in shredboost/shredspace Source/PluginEditor.*

Implement Source/StateManager.h/.cpp:
- XML/ValueTree state with schema_version field
- A/B slots (copy current ↔ A/B, swap)
- learned noise profile storage blob/subtree
- DI alignment result storage (offset, confidence, metadata)
- factory presets loaded read-only from Resources/Presets/ (directory may be empty placeholder; loader must not crash)
- user presets via juce::File::getSpecialLocation per-user app data under a ChugGate folder
- APIs to serialize/apply through the processor APVTS without audio-thread allocations in the public save/load paths where practical

Implement Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp:
- ChugGateAudioProcessorEditor skeleton hosting processor reference
- Minimal resized/paint so Standalone opens a window
- createEditor in processor already returns this type — ensure linkage

If CMake must list StateManager.cpp, only add that source line; do not restructure the whole build file.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: StateManager persists schema_version in saved XML/ValueTree state
StateManager supports A/B slots and storage for learned noise profile and DI alignment results
StateManager loads factory presets from Resources/Presets/ as read-only and user presets from per-user app data
Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp define ChugGateAudioProcessorEditor skeleton that constructs from ChugGateAudioProcessor
CMakeLists.txt includes StateManager.cpp in plugin/test targets if required to link
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change bus layout / isBusesLayoutSupported logic except editor linkage
add cloud or network preset services

allowed: create empty Resources/Presets/.gitkeep or placeholder factory XML
minimal editor UI with plugin name label only
forbidden: replace APVTS with custom binary-only state format
